labelTitle: BAKERS BEST Arthritis Pain Relief Cream with Hemp and Lavender
quick: All FDA label sections are shown verbatim below
indications: Indications: For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints, associated with arthritis, simple back aches, strains, bruises, and sprains.

label.Active ingredient: Active Ingredients Histamine DHCL (0.03%) Purpose Topical Analgesic
label.Other label text:
Drug Facts
Additional Information: Store at room temperature.
label.Indications and usage: Indications: For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints, associated with arthritis, simple back aches, strains, bruises, and sprains.
label.Dosage and administration: Directions: Adults and children two-years of age or older: Apply to affected area not more than three to four times daily. Children under two-years of age: consult a physician.
label.Warnings: Warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If symptoms persist for more than seven days, discontinue use and consult a physician. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, consult a physician ASAP. Do not apply to wounds or damaged skin. Do not bandage tightly. If pregnant or breast feeding, contact a physician prior to use.
